request.description: `health`: check that the backend is running.
`list_claims`: the queue with the state of each claim.

item.name: Workflow
item.description: Moves CLM-1001, CLM-1002 and CLM-1010 through the queue, so it changes the data. Run `uv run -m backend.seed` first to start from fresh data.

request.description: `start_run`: a run of the agent, capped at a number of claims, that the claims below start in.
`start_claim`: start a waiting claim in the run.
`record_step`: one step the agent took.
`list_steps`: the steps in order.
`decide_claim`: an approval at or under $1,000 stays in progress until it is paid.
`pay_claim`: pays the approved payout.
`pay_claim`: paying a claim twice is refused.
`list_claims` carries each claim's latest decision, payout and payment.
`start_claim`: start a waiting claim in the run.
`decide_claim`: an approval over $1,000 waits for sign-off.
`pay_claim` is refused over $1,000, even if the agent tries.

exec: pm.test("refused", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql("A payout over $1,000.00 waits for a handler's sign-off"));

item.name: Sign off CLM-1002 as Dana Whitfield

request.description: `sign_off_claim`: a handler releases the payment.
`start_claim`: start a waiting claim in the run.
`decide_claim`: a referral waits for a handler.
`decide_as_handler`: a handler approves the referred claim, which pays it.

item.name: Runs
item.description: Run after the Workflow folder, on fresh data: the run's to-do list, usage, a failed claim and the finish.

request.description: `write_todos`: replace the run's to-do list.
`record_usage`: one model call's tokens, cost and time.
`start_claim`: start a waiting claim in the run.
`fail_claim`: work on the claim failed; it goes back in the queue.
`get_latest_run`: the run, with what it started and used.
`finish_run`: finish the run with its summary for the handlers.

item.name: Insights
item.description: Run after the Workflow folder, on fresh data: sums up what the workflow did.

request.description: `get_insights`: the agent's work on the queue: outcomes, time, tools and money.

exec: pm.test("three claims decided by the agent", () => pm.expect(totals.decided).to.eql(3));
pm.test("one sign-off and one referral", () => { pm.expect(totals.sign_offs).to.eql(1); pm.expect(totals.referred).to.eql(1); });
pm.test("no claim waits for a handler", () => pm.expect(totals.waiting_for_handler).to.eql(0));
pm.test("the recorded step counts as a get_claim call", () => pm.expect(insights.tools).to.eql([{ tool: "get_claim", calls: 1, refused: 0 }]));

item.name: Agent
item.description: Starts and stops the UnderCover Agent. Run CLM-1003 calls the model for a moment before Stop ends it.

request.description: `get_agent`: whether the agent is running, and on which claim.
`run_claim` is refused for a claim that isn't waiting. Run after the Workflow folder, which decides CLM-1001.

exec: pm.test("refused", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql("Claim CLM-1001 is decided, not waiting"));

request.description: `run_claim`: starts the agent on one waiting claim. This calls the model in MODEL_NAME, or GPT-6 Luna by default; the next requests stop it within a second.
`run_queue` is refused while a run is going.
`stop_agent`: ends the run and puts the claim being worked back to waiting, keeping its steps.
`get_claim`: after Stop, the claim is back in the queue.
